'''Yowvetch custard-filled donuts''' were a type of [[Doughnut/Legends|donut]] filled with [[yowvetch custard]]. The recipe for making Yowvetch custard-filled donuts was among the 2400 donut recipes kept on the database of a [[Crisp-E-O donut droid]] owned by the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]]. The [[Dexter Jettster's Crisp-E-O donut droid|droid]] made use of its internal [[Oil/Legends|oil]] fryer to make the donuts in a traditional [[Adarian/Legends|Adarian]] style, and did so every morning. The donuts were then served in [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], an [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] owned by Jettster and located in the [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] district of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Yowvetch custard-filled donuts were one of several types of donut which were always available at Dex's due to their popularity and the fact Jettster considered them delicious, costing 1.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] each. They were served at the eatery<ref name="DaD" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Yowvetch custard-filled donuts were featured in the [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] exclusive article, "[[Dining at Dex's]]," which was written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner.<ref name="DaD" />
